title: Gyma — Workout Tracker
description: I designed and built Gyma, a personal workout tracker that turns complex training data into a calm, session-first experience. From live logging and rest timers to progression, history, and cloud sync, the product reduces friction in the gym while keeping every set measurable and meaningful.
cardDescription: A workout tracker I designed and built, with live logging, rest timers, progression and history in a calm, session-first app.
